notes.title: To celebrate the reveal of our new game Brave Furries will be free forever!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have just announced our new upcoming title. The Dragoness: Command of the Flame. You can check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413580/The_Dragoness_Command_of_the_Flame/

To celebrate this we have decided to make Brave Furries free forever. This is a heads up announcement required by Steam. Hopefully, they will agree to the price change within 10 days.

Regards,
Crazy Goat Games

notes.title: Brave Furries in summer sale 75% off!
notes.content:
Because we love when people play our games we are happy to announce that Brave Furries will participate in summer sale with a 75% discount! 

So do not buy the game now. Wait for the sale :)

notes.title: Space Scrapper has almost 1000 yes votes!
notes.content:
Our next game Space Scrapper (also a puzzle :) ) has now almost 1000 yes votes on Greenlight! Thank you! 

But we still need a bit more since the game is not greenlit yet :(
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=868920477

We know it is a bit of work to vote (yes/no) but maybe you could do this for us?  Pretty please :)
